Step 3 [SEO]: Structure the page with a primary H1 heading (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add one primary <h1> element containing the main headline of the page.

Step 4 [SEO]: Resolve robots.txt access or configuration issues (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Ensure your web server or CDN returns a valid 200 plain text robots.txt file, or a clean HTTP 404 if no rules are needed.
Step 5 [ACCESSIBILITY]: Add HTML language attribute to root element (EASY | Est Time: 9 mins) - Add the lang attribute to the root HTML element, e.g. <html lang="en">.

Step 6 [SEO]: Provide a valid canonical URL link tag (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add the page's intended canonical URL using the project's existing SEO configuration. Verify the authoritative URL before deployment.
Step 7 [SEO]: Provide a valid, accessible sitemap.xml (EASY | Est Time: 30 mins) - Ensure the sitemap endpoint responds reliably to HTTP requests without server errors or timeouts.

Step 8 [SEO]: Provide essential Open Graph metadata for social sharing (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add the missing Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type) to your document <head>.

Step 9 [SEO]: Provide Twitter Card metadata for X / Twitter link previews (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> along with twitter:title and twitter:image to the document <head>.
